$comment: Environment variables src/main reads that a packaged app still obeys (APP_ENV_VARS in src/main/testHooks.ts, plus platform variables). The test hooks a packaged app ignores are TEST_HOOK_VARS there and need no entry. tools/guards/envVars.test.ts fails on a read of any other name. Only shrinks.
SLATE_E2E: Marks an e2e run: keeps windows hidden and enables the e2e fakes. Scrubbed from a packaged release (E2E_BUILD_VARS in src/main/testHooks.ts); only the packaged e2e build (a build-time define, electron-vite --mode e2e) obeys it.
SLATE_E2E_SHOW: Shows the hidden e2e window on CI's virtual display; only read when SLATE_E2E=1, and scrubbed from a packaged release like SLATE_E2E.
SLATE_USER_DATA: Moves the data folder (e2e and the MCP/import CLIs point at a scratch folder). Any local user can already choose where the app reads its data.
SLATE_MS_CLIENT_ID: A Microsoft app registration id for OneNote import; public, not a secret.
SLATE_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS: Shortens the background sync interval; changes timing only.
SLATE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID: A GitHub OAuth app id for device sign-in; public, not a secret.
SLATE_SAFE_THEME: Starts with the built-in theme, to recover from a theme that makes the app unreadable.
SLATE_ONE2HTML: Path of the one2html converter for OneNote backups, for development builds that have not bundled it.
ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL: Set by electron-vite in development only: the dev server the window loads.
SHELL: The user's login shell, to find the claude CLI for theme generation.
VITEST: Set by the test runner; lets crash injection run in unit tests.
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: Linux's per-user runtime folder, where the MCP socket lives (mcp/socketPath.ts).
APPIMAGE: Set by the AppImage runtime; tells the updater the app runs as an AppImage (update/capability.ts).
